chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “When a man and a woman are found in a single blanket, each of them is lashed one hundred times.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the ruling
key_terms.لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ: a single blanket or covering shared by both persons

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man and a woman are found together under one blanket according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a man and a woman found together in one blanket. In the context of jurisprudence, it addresses a prescribed corporal punishment and reflects the strict treatment of conduct associated with illicit sexual impropriety.
